# Adopts From Metadata

## Summary
`meta.adoptsFrom` is the type pointer of every card resource: a code ref
`{ module, name }` naming the exported definition the instance adopts.

```json
"meta": { "adoptsFrom": { "module": "../invoice", "name": "Invoice" } }
```

## Invariants
- `module` may be realm-relative (resolved against the instance URL) or an
  absolute URL; the index always reports it resolved-absolute in search
  results.
- `name` is the export name; default exports use `"default"`.
- If the ref does not resolve to an exported definition, the instance
  errors at indexing — the realm serves the error, not the card.

## Example
```json
"meta": { "adoptsFrom": { "module": "../invoice", "name": "Invoice" } }
```
```json
"meta": { "adoptsFrom": { "module": "https://cardstack.com/base/card-api", "name": "Theme" } }
```
Resolution in code:
```ts
import { resolveRef } from 'https://cardstack.com/base/card-api';
```
